a: A GraphQL schema defines types, queries, and mutations.
Resolvers fetch the data for each field in a query.
REST resources are typically nouns in URLs, acted on by HTTP methods.
Batch endpoints reduce chatty clients by combining operations.
Long polling holds a request open until new data is available.
SSE streams server-to-client events over HTTP.
WebSockets are bidirectional; HTTP request/response is not.
Protocol Buffers serialize structured data compactly.
Avro is a schema-based data serialization system.
Contract tests ensure client and server agree on the API shape.
